title: Power interruption suspends classes in parts of Ilocos Sur on Nov. 17
summary: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Classes in affected public and private schools at all levels in parts of Magsingal, Ilocos Sur, will be suspended on Tuesday, Nov. 17, due to a scheduled…

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Classes in affected public and private schools at all levels in parts of Magsingal, Ilocos Sur, will be suspended on Tuesday, Nov. 17, due to a scheduled eight-hour power interruption. The Ilocos Sur Electric Cooperative Inc. (Iseco) said the power interruption will run from 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
